definition: a thin stretchy sheet of material
description: In a dim art gallery, a tall wooden stand holds a thin, stretched, milky plastic sheet, lit from behind by a spotlight. A young woman with long platinum hair, in a long black dress, presses against the sheet from behind with her palms raised and her eyes closed, and pushes her face further into it, so that the thin sheet stretches and wrinkles around her hands and face. At the left a young man in the shadows covers his mouth in surprise. A floor light and coiled cables lie nearby.
